candidate: First same-side strict penetration and reclaim in an eligible UTC 12H bar, checked at each of its first 11 completed hours. Direction is the developing 12H EMA20/50 from the prior confirmed EMA state and the current hourly close.
weekly_policy: At most one early candidate per New York week. Stop looking if the formal 12H confirmation has already occurred. The original confirmation stream is also tracked independently.
match: Original weekly first signal on the same 12H bar and side.
price_comparison: Use the actual next hourly open after each decision. A lower long entry or a higher short entry improves the price.
risk_diagnostic: Report any touch of the original ETH stop 1.5% beyond the pierced rail, starting at the candidate's next hourly open and ending at the formal 12H close.
scope: Exploratory signal-timing census. No trade simulation, net returns or account P&L.
